d:
Official video for D.C. based singer and songwriter Vidya’s 2015 cover of Selena Gomez's billboard smash hit "Same Old Love," from the album Revival and "Meri Sapno Ki Rani" by Kishore Kumar, produced by S.D.Burman.
Vidya Vox Inquiries:
Old is gold! I decided to mix my mom's favorite song, "Mere Sapno Ki Rani," by Kishore Kumar with Selena Gomez's new single "Same Old Love." Here's our take and we decided to give both of them a modern dance twist, hope you enjoy! We also got a bit playful with the video ;) Thank you Shankar Tucker, once again, for your magic on the music production!
